verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own docs cover the full headless loop: credentials saved locally for Python/CLI sessions, the DuckDB CLI connecting directly to MotherDuck, and the remote MCP server letting agents explore schemas and run read-only or read-write SQL. Results can also come back through the SDKs or the Postgres endpoint, so no dashboard is needed. Governance is documented through read-only MCP restriction, role-scoped Shares with include patterns, and an org-wide QUERY_HISTORY view. Missing for 10: detailed docs on non-interactive agent authentication (e.g., service tokens), and independent or hands-on proof of an agent running the whole flow end to end.
